system.longDesc:
A portable, water-proof bundle of medical supplies for essential first aid and basic treatment including adhesive medical tape, analgesics, antibiotics, chemical heat and cold packs, disinfectant, gauze, infrared thermometer, med-injector (previously), scalpels, scissors, surgical gloves, and a surgical “stapler” for closing wounds. A med-kit has sufficient supplies for a dozen applications of the First Aid action, or three days of extended medical attention for one patient, before it needs replenishment.

Resources TN 12.
